Four linear experts and a softmax gate,.zh: 四个线性专家与一个 softmax 门控网络，在你的浏览器中于一个分段二维回归任务上联合训练。观察门控如何将输入平面划分为四个区域、各专家如何在其区域内专精化，以及负载均衡辅助损失如何唤醒「死亡」专家。可在软混合与 top-1 硬路由之间切换。
Four linear experts and a softmax gate,.src:
Four linear experts and a softmax gate, trained jointly in
          your browser on a piecewise 2-D regression. Watch the gate
          carve the input plane into four regions, the experts
          specialise inside their regions, and the load-balancing
          auxiliary loss wake up dead experts. Toggle soft mixture
          vs top-1 hard routing.

@@T0@@~18 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Dee.zh:
@@T0@@约 18 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@深度学习 · 稀疏模型 · 路由@@T3@@

A single dense network has to learn one.zh: 单一稠密网络必须为每个输入学习同一个函数。随着模型增大，参数更多意味着每次前向传播的计算量也更大 — 容量的代价与容量本身呈线性增长。
A single dense network has to learn one.src:
A single dense network has to learn one function for every
          input. As models grow, more parameters means more compute on
          every forward pass — the cost of capacity scales
          linearly with capacity itself.

Mixture of Experts decouples them. You h.zh: 专家混合模型将二者解耦。你拥有 $E$ 个专家网络和一个小型@@T0@@门控网络@@T1@@。对于每个输入，门控选取一个或两个专家，只有被选中的专家参与计算。一个模型的参数量可以是同等稠密模型的 8 倍，而计算量却约为 1 倍 — 前提是路由足够稀疏。
Mixture of Experts decouples them. You h.src: Mixture of Experts decouples them. You have $E$ expert networks and a small gating network. For each input, the gate picks one or two experts; only those run. A model can have 8× the parameters of a dense counterpart but cost roughly 1× the compute — provided routing is sparse.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ MoE pays for par.zh: @@T0@@一句话概括。@@T1@@ MoE 为参数付出的代价在内存，而非浮点运算量。截至 2026 年，所有前沿规模的模型（GPT-OSS、Mixtral、DeepSeek-V3、Llama-MoE）在某种意义上都属于 MoE。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ MoE pays for par.src: The slogan. MoE pays for parameters in memory, not in flops. As of 2026 every frontier-scale model (GPT-OSS, Mixtral, DeepSeek-V3, Llama-MoE) is some flavour of MoE.

Each expert $f_e$ is a function (we use.zh: 每个专家 $f_e$ 是一个函数（此处采用线性形式：$f_e(x) = w_e^\top x + b_e$）。门控 $g(x) \in \Delta^E$ 是对 $E$ 个 logit 的 softmax。模型输出为加权混合；梯度同时流入各专家（在被用到之处）与门控（后者获得推动其走向更优路由的信号）。
Each expert $f_e$ is a function (we use.src:
Each expert $f_e$ is a function (we use linear:
          $f_e(x) = w_e^\top x + b_e$). The gate $g(x) \in \Delta^E$
          is a softmax over $E$ logits. The model output is a weighted
          mixture; the gradient flows into both the experts (where
          they were used) and the gate (which gets a signal pushing it
          toward better routings).

Hard top-1 routing replaces the soft mix.zh: 硬 top-1 路由以 $\hat e = \arg\max g_e(x)$ 取代软混合 — 每个输入仅有一个专家参与计算。我们采用直通式梯度，使门控仍然能够学习。
Hard top-1 routing replaces the soft mix.src:
Hard top-1 routing replaces the soft mixture with
          $\hat e = \arg\max g_e(x)$ — only one expert runs
          per input. We use a straight-through gradient so the gate
          still learns.

The toy task: a 2-D plane carved into fo.zh: 玩具任务：将一个二维平面划分为四个象限，每个象限对应一个不同的线性真值函数。单个线性模型无法拟合；而四个线性专家加一个门控则可以。
The toy task: a 2-D plane carved into fo.src:
The toy task: a 2-D plane carved into four quadrants, each
          with a different linear truth function. A single linear
          model can't fit it; four linear experts plus a gate can.

Gating regions (one colour per expert).zh: 门控区域（每个专家一种颜色）

Loss curve + expert utilisation.zh: 损失曲线 + 专家利用率

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@值得关注之处。@@T1@@
          在@@T2@@软混合@@T3@@且无均衡损失时，门控有时会坍塌到单一专家（@@T4@@死亡专家@@T5@@问题）。开启@@T6@@负载均衡@@T7@@后，均衡项会惩罚不均衡的利用；四路划分通常在约 150 步内出现。切换到@@T8@@top-1@@T9@@即为 Switch-Transformer 式的路由 — 此时出现的不是平滑的 softmax 混合，而是类似 Voronoi 的区域边界。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. With soft mixture + no balance loss the gate sometimes collapses onto a single expert (dead expert problem). Turn on load-balance and the balance term penalises uneven utilisation; the four-way split usually appears within ~150 steps. Switch to top-1 for the Switch-Transformer-style routing — Voronoi-like region boundaries appear instead of a smooth softmax mixture.

Without intervention the gate has every.zh: 若不加以干预，门控完全有理由坍塌：最容易落入的局部极小值就是「总是选择专家 1」。辅助损失则推动门控趋向均匀利用：
Without intervention the gate has every.src:
Without intervention the gate has every reason to collapse:
          the easiest local minimum is "always pick expert 1". The
          auxiliary loss pushes the gate toward uniform utilisation:

$f_e$ is the fraction of tokens routed t.zh: $f_e$ 是被路由至专家 $e$ 的词元比例，$P_e$ 是该批次上专家 $e$ 的平均门控概率。当二者都均匀（$1/E$）时该乘积取最小。Switch Transformer 一文提出了这一确切形式，现代所有 MoE 均采用之。
$f_e$ is the fraction of tokens routed t.src:
$f_e$ is the fraction of tokens routed to expert $e$ and
          $P_e$ is the average gate probability for expert $e$ over
          the batch. The product is minimised when both are uniform
          ($1/E$). The Switch Transformer paper introduced this exact
          form and it's what every modern MoE uses.

What scales, what hurts, what production.zh: 什么能规模化、什么会造成损害、生产部署是什么样的
What scales, what hurts, what production.src: What scales, what hurts, what production looks like

@@T0@@Switch Transformer (Fedus et al.,.zh:
@@T0@@Switch Transformer（Fedus 等，2021）。@@T1@@
            每个词元使用一个专家（top-1）。在质量不变的前提下展示了 4 倍加速。
@@T0@@Switch Transformer (Fedus et al.,.src: Switch Transformer (Fedus et al., 2021). One expert per token (top-1). Demonstrated 4× speed-ups at constant quality.

@@T0@@Mixtral 8×7B (Mistral, 2023).@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@Mixtral 8×7B（Mistral，2023）。@@T1@@ 在 8 个专家间做 top-2 路由；仅 top-2 门控对应的专家参与计算；有效参数量约 47B，每个词元激活约 13B。
@@T0@@Mixtral 8×7B (Mistral, 2023).@@T1@.src: Mixtral 8×7B (Mistral, 2023). Top-2 routing across 8 experts; only the experts of the top-2 gates run; effective parameter count ~47B with ~13B active per token.

@@T0@@DeepSeek-MoE (2024).@@T1@@ Many sm.zh: @@T0@@DeepSeek-MoE（2024）。@@T1@@ 众多小专家（256 个以上），路由粒度更细。通过门控上各专家的偏置实现无辅助损失的均衡。
@@T0@@DeepSeek-MoE (2024).@@T1@@ Many sm.src: DeepSeek-MoE (2024). Many small experts (256+) with finer-grained routing. Auxiliary-loss-free balancing via per-expert biases on the gate.

@@T0@@Common pitfalls.@@T1@@ Routing ins.zh: @@T0@@常见陷阱。@@T1@@ 训练早期路由不稳定；若辅助损失过小或缺失，专家会坍塌；在规模较大时，ALL-to-ALL 通信会主导训练时间；「专家容量」溢出需要丢弃词元或重新路由。
@@T0@@Common pitfalls.@@T1@@ Routing ins.src: Common pitfalls. Routing instability during early training; experts collapse if the auxiliary loss is too small or absent; ALL-to-ALL communication dominates training time at large scale; "expert capacity" overflow needs token dropping or re-routing.

@@T0@@What MoE does @@T1@@not@@T2@@ save.zh:
@@T0@@MoE @@T1@@不能@@T2@@为你省下的东西。@@T3@@
            推理内存：每个专家的权重仍须驻留于 GPU/TPU 内存中。MoE 省的是浮点运算量，费的是内存。
@@T0@@What MoE does @@T1@@not@@T2@@ save.src: What MoE does not save you. Inference memory: every expert's weights still need to be in GPU/TPU memory. MoE is FLOP-cheap, RAM-expensive.

Where MoE shows up beyond LLMs.zh: MoE 在 LLM 之外的用武之地
Where MoE shows up beyond LLMs.src: Where MoE shows up beyond LLMs

@@T0@@Multi-task and multi-domain models.zh:
@@T0@@多任务与多领域模型。@@T1@@
            每个任务领域一个专家；由门控学习路由。当多种传感器模态或任务类型共享同一骨干网络时尤为有用。
@@T0@@Multi-task and multi-domain models.src: Multi-task and multi-domain models. One expert per task domain; the gate learns the routing. Useful when many sensor modalities or task types share a backbone.

@@T0@@Time-series with MoE.@@T1@@ Differ.zh:
@@T0@@结合 MoE 的时间序列。@@T1@@
            针对不同时间模式（活动识别、睡眠、心率）使用不同专家。门控由此成为一个软性的状态分类器。
@@T0@@Time-series with MoE.@@T1@@ Differ.src: Time-series with MoE. Different experts for different temporal patterns (activity recognition vs sleep vs heart-rate). The gate becomes a soft regime classifier.

@@T0@@Multimodal models.@@T1@@ Image vs.zh:
@@T0@@多模态模型。@@T1@@
            图像、文本与音频各有其专家模块；门控按模态路由（通常为硬 top-1）。
@@T0@@Multimodal models.@@T1@@ Image vs.src: Multimodal models. Image vs text vs audio expert blocks; gate routes per modality (often hard top-1).

@@T0@@Conditional computation in vision..zh:
@@T0@@视觉中的条件计算。@@T1@@
            在卫星或医学图像中，针对不同的尺度 / 区域使用不同专家。
@@T0@@Conditional computation in vision..src: Conditional computation in vision. Different experts for different scales / regions in satellite or medical images.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n M.zh:
@@T0@@最终结论。@@T1@@
          MoE 是让模型在单位参数上获得更多「知识」的最廉价方式。只要路由足够稀疏且均衡机制到位，你就能在不增加浮点运算量的情况下获得容量。一旦拥有它，稠密式扩展就显得浪费。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n M.src: Final takeaway. MoE is the cheapest way to give a model more "knowledge" per parameter. As long as routing is sparse and balancing is in place, you get capacity without flops. Once you have it, dense scaling looks wasteful.

Expert parallelism — the systems story.zh: 专家并行 — 系统层面的故事

Past ~1B parameters per expert, you can'.zh: 当单个专家参数量超过约 1B 时，你无法把所有专家放入一块 GPU。标准的分片模式如下（Lepikhin 等，2020）：
Past ~1B parameters per expert, you can'.src: Past ~1B parameters per expert, you can't fit all experts on one GPU. The standard sharding pattern (Lepikhin et al., 2020):

@@T0@@Expert parallelism.@@T1@@ Place di.zh: @@T0@@专家并行。@@T1@@ 将不同专家放置于不同设备上。每台设备持有专家的一个子集。
@@T0@@Expert parallelism.@@T1@@ Place di.src: Expert parallelism. Place different experts on different devices. Each device holds a subset of experts.

@@T0@@All-to-all dispatch.@@T1@@ For eac.zh: @@T0@@全对全分发。@@T1@@ 对每一批词元，将其发送到承载其被选专家的设备；在本地运行该专家；再将输出送回。每层需要两次全对全集合通信。
@@T0@@All-to-all dispatch.@@T1@@ For eac.src: All-to-all dispatch. For each batch of tokens, send tokens to the device hosting their chosen expert; run the expert locally; send outputs back. This is two all-to-all collectives per layer.

@@T0@@Expert capacity.@@T1@@ Each expert.zh: @@T0@@专家容量。@@T1@@ 每个专家在每批次中拥有固定的槽位数（例如 $1.25 \times \text{tokens}/E$）。溢出的词元会被@@T2@@丢弃@@T3@@（输出为零）或被@@T4@@重新路由@@T5@@到次选专家。容量因子是速度（容量低、丢弃多）与质量（容量高、计算多）之间的一个旋钮。
@@T0@@Expert capacity.@@T1@@ Each expert.src: Expert capacity. Each expert has a fixed slot count per batch (e.g. $1.25 \times \text{tokens}/E$). Overflowing tokens get dropped (zero-output) or re-routed to the second-choice expert. The capacity factor is a knob between speed (low capacity, more drops) and quality (high capacity, more compute).

@@T0@@Pipelining + tensor parallelism.@@.zh: @@T0@@流水线并行 + 张量并行。@@T1@@ 在标准三维并行之上叠加专家并行。每台设备运行某一阶段的专家，并以分片形式存放。
@@T0@@Pipelining + tensor parallelism.@@.src: Pipelining + tensor parallelism. Stack expert parallelism on top of standard 3D parallelism. Each device runs one stage's experts, sharded.

The all-to-all is what makes MoE trainin.zh: 正是全对全通信使得 MoE 训练系统如此困难。相关框架有：GShard、Tutel、Megablocks、DeepSpeed-MoE。
The all-to-all is what makes MoE trainin.src: The all-to-all is what makes MoE training systems hard. Frameworks: GShard, Tutel, Megablocks, DeepSpeed-MoE.

Aux load-balance loss; expert capacity.zh: 辅助负载均衡损失；专家容量

Routing balance via aux loss; sparsity a.zh: 通过辅助损失实现路由均衡；训练时采用稀疏性
Routing balance via aux loss; sparsity a.src: Routing balance via aux loss; sparsity at training

Open-weight; outperforms Llama-2 70B.zh: 开放权重；性能优于 Llama-2 70B

Aux-loss-free balancing via per-expert b.zh: 通过各专家偏置实现无辅助损失的均衡

Same architecture, scaled experts.zh: 相同架构，专家规模扩大

@@T0@@Jacobs, Jordan, Nowlan, Hinton (19.src: Jacobs, Jordan, Nowlan, Hinton (1991) — Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts. The original MoE paper.

@@T0@@Shazeer et&nbsp;al. (2017)@@T1@@ —.src: Shazeer et al. (2017) — Outrageously Large Neural Networks. Top-k gating, MoE inside Transformers.

@@T0@@Lepikhin et&nbsp;al. (2020)@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Lepikhin 等 (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@GShard。@@T3@@ 专家并行的系统论文。

meta.title: 专家混合模型实战
meta.tagline: Mixtral 与 DeepSeek-MoE 如何在不增加计算量的情况下扩展参数量
meta.summary: 在你的浏览器中，于一个分段二维回归任务上联合训练四个线性专家与一个 softmax 门控。观察门控如何将输入平面划分为四个区域、各专家如何在其区域内专精化，以及负载均衡辅助损失如何防止专家死亡。可在软混合与 top-1 路由之间切换。
highlights: 在分段平面上对 4 个专家 + 一个门控网络进行实时联合训练。
切换软混合与 top-1 硬路由 — 观察稀疏专家如何专精化。
一键加入负载均衡辅助损失；观察死亡的专家被唤醒。
专家归属区域的平面可视化，并叠加预测误差。
